custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573672 VENDOR A in Name *, then click Save & Close.
  • Have a special-order number that the test location received from vendor A within the last 12 months, the received number, so the lookup has a result it must show with vendor A.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573672 LINE S in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options; type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573672-SO in Part Number and pick Add new special order part, type a Description, 1 in Quantity, pick vendor A under Vendor and type a Cost, then click Save Part; order it and receive it from vendor A on the Receive screen (Purchase Orders in the left menu, Receive on its row, Vendor Invoice #, Invoice Date, Qty received, then the Receive Parts button).
  • Create a special order for this test from vendor A on a work order line, with a new part number, the ordered number, and order it, but receive it nowhere.
    • How to do it: The same way, with the number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573672-ORD, but do not receive it.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573672 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, then click Save & Close.
  • Start on work order 1 (Work Orders in the top bar, then open work order 1).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Part Request" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The received number is offered with the source "Part Library · " followed by vendor A's name.

Step 3:

  • No result for the ordered number shows the source "Part Library · " with vendor A's name: a number ordered but not yet received is not a special-order result.

Step 4:

  • The window closes, and work order 1's line shows no new part request.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S12-R14a: “A special-order lookup result is a part number this location received from a vendor on a special-order line (a received line with no inventory part, and not a core) in the last 12 months.”
  • S12-R14: “A special-order lookup result shows its source as "Part Library · {vendor}".”

From: Product's answers (Chris Ward, 9 Oct and 14 Oct 2026, saved in po-answers-2026-10-09/ and po-answers-2026-10-14/), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 14 Oct 2026, answer 2: “A special-order result is a part number this location received from a vendor on a special-order line in the last 12 months. That's a received line with no inventory part, and not a core (S12-R14a). If more than one vendor delivered it, the vendor of the most recent delivery shows (S12-R14b).”

Partly checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026; not yet seen on that build: ordering and receiving a special-order part (the New Part Request window offered "Add new special order part" once, then "No results").
